outcome: Vortex characteristics (number, position, length, width, area, duration) in bilateral ventricles
Cardiac morphology parameters (pulmonary annular diameter z-scores, sphericity index (SI) of RV)
Ventricular function (isovolumic relaxation time (IRT), myocardial performance index of RV)
cohort: The study included 35 fetuses diagnosed with Tetralogy of Fallot and 35 gestational age-matched control fetuses.
finding: Fetuses with Tetralogy of Fallot exhibited distinct vortex characteristics in the right ventricle, with some vortex features, particularly RV vortex area, being closely associated with RV anatomical and functional abnormalities.
gest_age: Fetuses were gestational age-matched between the TOF and control groups.
